data: Amazon's diluted EPS was $7.17 in fiscal 2025, up from $5.53 in fiscal 2024, an increase of about 29.7%. Net income for fiscal 2025 was roughly $77.7 billion, compared with $59.2 billion in fiscal 2024. I'm giving these figures from memory rather than from a filing I just checked, so please confirm them against Amazon's 10-K for fiscal 2025 before relying on them. Note also that 2025 results included sizable pre-tax gains from Amazon's investment in Anthropic, which helped lift net income and EPS.
